notes: TaskOrderV3 has 28 top-level fields and binds a raw Hash32 model ID.
Plaintext Phase 0 requires payload_mode PLAINTEXT, zero32 input_key_commitment and an empty user_recipient_pubkey.
The 20-field order opening remains under TRUEOPEN_ORDER_OPENING_V2 and also uses the raw model ID.
Each mutation recomputes a digest after changing one encoded leaf of the V3 field list.
